AND (#{keyword} = '' OR m.subject LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR m.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
mapper.select:
WITH candidates AS ( (SELECT m.mail_id, m.send_time FROM mail m FORCE INDEX (idx_sender_cursor) WHERE m.sender_id = #{userId} AND m.sender_deleted = FALSE AND m.mail_status = 1
AND (m.send_time < #{time} OR (m.send_time = #{time} AND m.mail_id < #{id}))
ORDER BY m.send_time DESC, m.mail_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}) UNION ALL (SELECT mr.mail_id, mr.mail_send_time AS send_time FROM mail_receiver mr FORCE INDEX (idx_receiver_search) STRAIGHT_JOIN mail m ON m.mail_id = mr.mail_id WHERE mr.receiver_id = #{userId} AND mr.is_deleted = FALSE AND m.mail_status = 1 AND NOT (m.sender_id = #{userId} AND m.sender_deleted = FALSE)
AND (mr.mail_send_time < #{time} OR (mr.mail_send_time = #{time} AND mr.mail_id < #{id}))
AND mr.id = (SELECT MIN(r.id) FROM mail_receiver r WHERE r.mail_id = mr.mail_id AND r.receiver_id = #{userId} AND r.is_deleted = FALSE) ORDER BY mr.mail_send_time DESC, mr.mail_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}) ) SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mail_star ms WHERE ms.user_id = #{userId} AND ms.mail_id = m.mail_id) is_starred, m.mail_id, m.sender_id, u.username sender_name, u.email sender_email, m.subject, LEFT(m.content, 50) content, m.send_time, m.has_attachment, m.is_spam, m.priority, m.mail_status, m.sender_deleted FROM candidates c JOIN mail m ON m.mail_id = c.mail_id JOIN user u ON u.user_id = m.sender_id ORDER BY c.send_time DESC, c.mail_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
